Young Belgrave Walkers pose after the 2 kilometres event at the Belgrave Open '7' at Wimbledon, 22nd November 1997.  Back row - Steve Whorlow Jnr., Laura Fryer, Kevin Baker - front row - Sam McNally, Lucy Asling and Paul Graham.
Paul Graham took the gold to become the National Champion, Sam McNally won the silver and with Stephen Whorlow Jnr. filling out the team in 6th. the Club took the team championship.

Belgrave originally had Andrew Goudie, Nigel Whorlow, Laura Fryer, Paul Graham, Sam McNally and Stephen Whorlow Jnr (reserve) selected for the South for this match but because of other commitments such as exams and over racing, only Paul and Sam were able to accept.
